body: GitHub secret names must match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*. Env keys legal under the Compose charset (dots, hyphens, digit-first) are not. After --strip-prefix, any selected key that violates the pattern fails the whole run, listing the offending keys. Why: partial pushes are worse than loud ones, and tool-invented name mangling is how secrets get orphaned.
title: Secret names are never renamed: an invalid name fails the whole push before any write
